summary: MassPanel Hosting License: paid hosting allowed; software resale requires authorization

components.name: MassPanel licence
components.description: Applies the MassPanel Hosting License 1.0 to original code, allowing paid hosting and accounts while requiring written authorization for software resale. Earlier AGPL rights and upstream licences remain intact.

components.name: Grommunio declaration
components.description: Records the exact modified grommunio Web file, base commit, purpose and modification date.

components.name: Corresponding source
components.description: Publishes the complete deployed source without authentication from the panel and mail hostnames.

components.name: Licence notices
components.description: Installs upstream licence texts, source hashes, independence notice and redistribution guidance.

components.name: Compliance gate
components.description: Refuses to build releases with missing notices, undeclared archives, checksum drift or a missing source offer.

components.name: Panel source routes
components.description: Publishes the source offer, source archive and licence on existing custom panel hostnames and new installations.

components.name: Public documentation
components.description: Adds installation, security, privacy, support, contribution, Cloudflare and release-gate documentation.

components.name: Release sanitization
components.description: Rejects Cloudflare-token and private-key patterns and removes generated Python caches from release archives.

components.name: Reliable updates
components.description: Avoids refreshing external package repositories when required firewall packages are already installed.

components.name: Public source defaults
components.description: Removes the original deployment mail hostname fallback and adds GitHub community templates.

components.name: Licence discovery
components.description: Updates source-available labels, preserves the former AGPL text and documents separately licensed integration modules.

components.name: GitHub source links
components.description: Links the panel and webmail disclosure pages to the public repository and matching version tag.

components.name: Repository metadata exclusion
components.description: Excludes Git metadata, virtual environments and development dependencies from signed release archives.
